summary.text: Sue Errington, a Democrat from Muncie, represents Indiana House District 34, which includes portions of Delaware County, and was first elected to the House in 2012.
She is the ranking minority member of the Environmental Affairs Committee and will retire at the conclusion of her term in November 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to her caucus biography, Errington served on the Delaware County Council and in the Indiana State Senate before her election to the House.
A February 2026 caucus release says she was first elected to the State Senate in 2006 and was honored on the House floor with House Resolution 24 for her years of service.
Before holding office she taught Spanish and later served 17 years as Public Policy Director for Planned Parenthood of Indiana and Kentucky.
She is also a member of the Elections and Apportionment Committee and vice chair of the Statutory Committee on Ethics.
Her community service includes the boards of Muncie OUTreach and the Second Harvest Food Bank and membership in the National Caucus of Environmental Legislators.
She lives in Muncie and has two married daughters and two grandchildren.
